[LSER.6.10.2] Four syntactic forms, from shortest to most
qualified:

| Form | Components | Required when |
|---|---|---|
| `binding` | binding only | single series-carrying slot, unlabelled observation |
| `binding.label` | binding + label | single series-carrying slot, labelled observation |
| `binding.slot` | binding + slot | multi-slot schema, unlabelled |
| `binding.slot.label` | binding + slot + label | multi-slot schema, labelled |
